Researcher profile / public identity

Reza Nirouyar

Independent researcher and project author working across finite affine systems, reproducible computational experiments, constructed symbolic systems, and evidence-focused evaluation of AI and language-model claims.

VARZIN ProjectIndependent researchGermany
Research position

VARZIN separates proved mathematics, computational findings, negative results, open empirical questions, planned studies, and historical hypotheses. Publication or archival presence is not treated as independent validation.

01 / current work

Research centered on structure, reproducibility, and falsification.

Finite systems

Affine and finite-state models

Formal and computational work on finite affine transformations, deterministic models, and explicitly scoped finite-state constructions.

Reproducibility

Auditable computational research

Versioned code, explicit assumptions, negative-result retention, correction history, and reproducibility packaging are treated as part of the research output.

LUXVAR

Constructed symbolic systems

LUXVAR is studied as a designed symbolic language whose structural regularities must be distinguished from independently recoverable semantics.

02 / evidence boundary

Designed structure is not presented as hidden meaning.

Supported within scope

Reproducible finite-system implementations, explicit constructed morphology, controlled computational comparisons, and documented negative findings.

Not established

Independent semantic emergence, universal or non-human origin, consciousness-field mechanisms, quantum validation, causal frequency effects, or broad real-world predictive validity.
